en.title: Israel's rival factions consider coalition deals on 27 November 2026

body: NPR reported that Israel's rival factions consider coalition deals.

problemsFixed: The draft contains unsupported claims, such as the duration of the deadlock or the suggestion that coalition building is the 'primary path forward' (speculation).
The draft uses evaluative language ('resolve government deadlock', 'prolonged impasse') which violates the neutral verb and no-opinion rules.
The body paragraphs are repetitive and contain filler/summary sentences that do not add new information.
The context section introduces external information not present in the sources.
